render_scale.doc: Ryujinx already runs the Switch at the Deck's limit at 1x (the game's own 720p handheld mode); its res_scale is left at 1, so nothing is offered.

doc.intent: Modern system: fullscreen first, optional cosmetic frame only when explicitly enabled.
doc.bios: Ryujinx needs dumped Switch keys and firmware from the user's console.
doc.extensions: Only what Ryujinx 1.3.3 loads (.xci, .nsp, .nca, .nro, .nso): it opens no archive, a .zip fails as unsupported homebrew, so neither is offered. None occurs in the library.

titles.doc: Switch dumps carry their title id in brackets, e.g. The Legend of Zelda Tears of the Kingdom [0100F2C0115B6000][v0][US].nsp; updates live in switch/updates and end in 800, so a base game is the only match at the top level.
